title: Dangote Cement to buy vessels to transport cement across Africa
summary: Dangote Cement to buy vessels to transport cement across Africa
body_markdown: **Nigeria:** Dangote Cement is reportedly ‘struggling’ to secure vessels for a 1000t shipment from Nigeria to neighbouring Ghana. The move comes as Nigeria attempts to rebuild domestic shipping capacity after decades of dependence on foreign vessels. The alternative, moving products by road, comes with high costs, such as fuel costs, border delays and taxes.
